tables.name: vendors
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE public."vendors" (
    "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
    "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "telefono" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'VENDOR',
    "activo" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
